quarterly_data.signal: As of December 31, 2025, MPS's total estimated future unconditional purchase commitments to suppliers and other parties were $442.2 million, of which $389.8 million was due within a year; they primarily consist of wafer and other inventory purchases, assembly and other manufacturing services, construction of manufacturing and R&D facilities, purchases of production and other equipment, and license arrangements. MPS also made an annually refundable deposit to a supplier (not named) under a long-term wafer supply agreement.
quarterly_data.figure: purchase commitments $442.2 million ($389.8 million due within a year) at December 31, 2025
